title: Price regime of the evaluation window
why: every headline number is conditioned on this window; Section 2.1 cited the FY2022 LNG crisis, which is training data only, and so implied spike coverage the evaluation era does not have
reading: near-floor slots outnumber slots at or above 50 JPY/kWh by 99 to 1. Weather enters this window through photovoltaic surplus at the lower tail, essentially never through scarcity at the upper tail, so every result here is a floor-regime result
